message:
## Overview

This PR adds full support for [Codeberg.org](https://codeberg.org) repositories, addressing the feature request in issue #XXX. Codeberg is a well-known Git hosting platform that runs on Gitea software, so the implementation leverages the existing Gitea adapter infrastructure.

## Changes

### Core Implementation

- **New `CodebergRepoSession` class** (`src/lastversion/repo_holders/codeberg.py`): A dedicated session class that inherits from `GiteaRepoSession` with `codeberg.org` as the default hostname. This provides proper behavior when using the `--at codeberg` flag.

- **Updated `HolderFactory`** (`src/lastversion/holder_factory.py`): Registered "codeberg" in the HOLDERS dictionary, positioned before "gitea" to ensure `codeberg.org` URLs are correctly matched.

- **Enhanced `GiteaRepoSession`** (`src/lastversion/repo_holders/gitea.py`): Added `is_matching_hostname()` method override for proper hostname matching and added `KNOWN_GITEA_HOSTS` list for future extensibility.

### Documentation & Tests

- **Added test coverage** (`tests/test_gitea.py`): New `test_codeberg_repo()` test to verify Codeberg functionality
- **Updated README files**: Both `README.md` and `README-ZH-CN.md` now list Codeberg and Gitea as supported sources
- **CLI documentation**: The `--at` flag help text now includes "codeberg" as an option

## Usage

Users can now retrieve version information from Codeberg repositories in multiple ways:

```bash
# Using full URL (as requested in the issue)
lastversion https://codeberg.org/readeck/readeck

# Using --at flag with short name
lastversion --at codeberg readeck/readeck

# Download source tarball
lastversion --download https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo
```

## Technical Details

The implementation uses Codeberg's Gitea-compatible API at `https://codeberg.org/api/v1`, querying endpoints like:
- `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/tags` for tag-based releases
- `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases` for formal releases

All standard lastversion features work with Codeberg repositories, including version filtering, pre-release detection, asset downloads, and source tarball retrieval.

## Testing

Comprehensive testing has verified:
- ✅ Codeberg URLs are correctly recognized and routed to `CodebergRepoSession`
- ✅ The `--at codeberg` flag properly defaults to `codeberg.org`
- ✅ API endpoints are correctly constructed
- ✅ Hostname matching works for both Codeberg and Gitea instances
- ✅ Backward compatibility with existing Gitea functionality is maintained

Closes #XXX
